import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [15, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 10

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True)

# Create gridspec
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# Plot 1: Sleep metrics by occupation
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
sleep_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
sleep_metrics.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['skyblue', 'lightcoral'])
ax1.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation')
ax1.set_ylabel('Score')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.legend(['Sleep Duration (hrs)', 'Sleep Quality (1-10)'])

# Plot 2: Physical activity vs daily steps
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], s=100, cmap='RdYlGn_r', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps (colored by Stress Level)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Stress Level')

# Plot 3: BMI distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = ['lightgreen' if cat == 'Normal' else 'salmon' if cat == 'Overweight' else 'coral' 
          for cat in bmi_counts.index]
ax3.bar(bmi_counts.index, bmi_counts.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 4: Heart rate by occupation
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
occupation_hr = df.groupby('Occupation')['Heart Rate'].mean()
ax4.bar(occupation_hr.index, occupation_hr.values, color='lightblue')
ax4.set_title('Average Heart Rate by Occupation')
ax4.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 5: Stress level distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
stress_counts = df['Stress Level'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax5.bar(stress_counts.index.astype(str), stress_counts.values, color='lightcoral')
ax5.set_title('Stress Level Distribution')
ax5.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')

# Plot 6: Sleep disorder presence
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
has_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'].apply(lambda x: 'Yes' if x else 'No')
disorder_counts = has_disorder.value_counts()
ax6.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=['lightgreen', 'lightcoral'], startangle=90)
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Presence')

# Plot 7: Correlation heatmap (numeric columns only)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax7)
ax7.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numeric Features')

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
